Appointed by the President based on recommendations of:
• Prime Minister
• Speaker of Lok Sabha
• Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha
• Chief Justice of India or nominee
• One eminent jurist
Appointed by the President based on recommendations of:

items: Exams frequently test the composition of the recommendation panel—ensure you remember all 5 members.
Note that the appointment is made by the President, but only upon the specific recommendation of this committee.
Pay attention to the inclusion of the Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha as a statutory panel member.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Appointments are formally made by the President of India.
The recommendation panel consists of five key figures from executive, legislative, and judicial branches.
Legislative representation includes both the Speaker of Lok Sabha and the Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha.
Judicial representation includes the Chief Justice of India (or their nominee) alongside one eminent jurist.
